hotels.title: Maldives Private Island Bliss with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Return Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Experience true Maldivian magic at Centara Mirage Lagoon, a private island oasis just 40 minutes from Malé. Sublime cuisine headlines this tropical gem, from freshly caught seafood at Acqua to authentic Thai flavours at the signature Suan Bua, where you can indulge in a private banquet or sip on cocktails at the vibrant rum bar. From sunrise to sunset, there's no shortage of entertainment for all - spend your days floating in the crystal-clear lagoon or dive into the thrill of the lazy river and water park. For couples and honeymooners, romance takes centre stage with sunset cruises, candlelit dinners and private villa picnics, while the acclaimed SPA Cenvaree offers next-level relaxation, complete with the magical Candy Spa to keep the little ones busy. With convenient speedboat transfers included in your package, arriving at Centara Mirage Lagoon Maldives couldn't be easier, allowing you to make the most of your trip from the moment you land in Malé. Admire the endless blue of the Indian Ocean as you glide seamlessly to your private slice of heaven, where your journey into bliss begins.

hotels.title: Five-Star Maldives Banyan Tree Retreat with PADI Dive Centre, House Reef & Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Castaway to paradise with a five-star stay at Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru, a secluded Maldives island retreat surrounded by snow-white sands and the endless blue beyond. Just a 20-minute catamaran ride from Malé's airport, with complimentary roundtrip speedboat transfers, this intimate resort includes an abundance of top-notch facilities. Enjoy beachside dining at Ilaafathi and Naiboli Bar, explore vast underwater kingdoms with the on-site PADI Dive Centre or head to celebrated Banyan Tree Spa for soul-soothing treatments.
